models.shared: aggregate capacity shared equally among active transfers; in-flight tracking
models.lockin_full: per-request rate fixed at request start and held (server scheduled-rate semantics)
models.serialized: one request served at a time at the current rate

trace_binning: 1 s aggregate capacity bins; zero bins at the documented 8000 bps M3 outage floor
determinism: no RNG; pseudo-random alternation uses a fixed LCG seed 12345
